primaryText.facts: Limestone exterior with brick/coursed stone on courtyard sides; stone slate roofs and tall stone stacks. French north half-H range has two storeys/attic,9 central upper window bays,3-window pavilion fronts and4-window side depth, arcaded ground loggia/round windows, mansards/alternating pediment dormers, pilasters/cornice/rustication. Long west two-storey range has crowning balustrade/cross-casement windows. East seven-window range has hipped roof/six dormers and intrinsic stepped French-door link. Earlier lower courtyard ranges/great hall retained. Technical facts only, no listing images/maps or interior decoration adopted.
